more.good_when: A maintainer who runs the tests on every push sees them pass on every run, whatever the wall clock says. Now test_a_stopped_run_is_retried_7_times_where_retries_isnt_given asserts that the minute the run started equals the minute it stopped, read off the real clock, so a run of the double that starts in one minute and stops in the next, such as at 12:59:59.95 and 13:00:00.05, fails the test though overnight did nothing wrong.

A maintainer who changes how `--retries` is read learns from a test when `overnight --retries 0 ...`, the fewest the command's refusal allows ("a whole number from 0"), stops starting a work. Now only -1 and `two` are tried at the command, so a change that refuses 0 too passes every test.
